sources.title: PIB · The land of artisans: Raghurajpur (11 April 2014)
sources.note: Sucharita Sahoo, 11 April 2014. Prepared cloth, narrative subjects and Gotipua. The dated feature is not evidence of present household numbers or performance availability.

sources.note: Traditional cloth preparation and painting sequence. Individual makers may use different materials; this is not a pigment recipe or a care guarantee.

sources.note: December 2005, pp. 68–70, especially p. 70. The revival passage cites Ileana Citaristi’s The Making of a Guru (2001); that book has not been independently checked for this revision.

sources.title: Srjan · Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra milestones
